name: SQL Injection Vulnerability
title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
description: This code uses string interpolation in a SQL query...

name: Hardcoded Credentials
description: This code contains hardcoded credentials (passwords, API keys, tokens), which is a security risk.
fix: Use environment variables or a secrets manager instead of hardcoded credentials.

name: Missing Null/Undefined Check
description: This function accesses object properties without checking if the object is null or undefined.
fix: Add null checks before accessing properties: if (!obj) return; or use optional chaining (?.)

name: Unhandled Async/Await
description: This async function may not handle errors properly. Unhandled promise rejections can crash the application.
fix: Wrap async operations in try/catch blocks or add .catch() handlers.

name: Console Statements in Production Code
description: This code contains console statements that should be removed in production.
fix: Remove console statements or use a proper logging framework.

name: Potential Infinite Loop
description: This code contains a while(true) loop without a break condition.
fix: Add a break condition or use a counter to prevent infinite loops.

name: Deprecated or Unsafe API
description: This code uses deprecated or unsafe APIs that should be updated.
fix: Use safer alternatives like fs.promises or async/await.

name: Missing Rate Limiting
description: This loop may process many items without rate limiting, potentially overwhelming APIs or databases.
fix: Add rate limiting or batching to prevent overwhelming resources.

name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
description: This code inserts user input directly into HTML without sanitization.
fix: Sanitize user input using DOMPurify or similar library.

name: Path Traversal Vulnerability
description: This code uses user input to construct file paths without validation.
fix: Validate and sanitize file paths, use path.resolve and check against root directory.

name: Weak Encryption
description: This code uses weak encryption algorithms (MD5, SHA1, DES, RC4).
fix: Use modern encryption algorithms like AES-256-GCM or bcrypt.

name: Missing Input Validation
description: This function accepts user input without validation.
fix: Add input validation using libraries like Joi, Yup, or Zod.

name: Potential Memory Leak
description: This code may cause memory leaks due to unremoved listeners or references.
fix: Remove event listeners when no longer needed, use WeakMap/WeakSet for references.

name: Hardcoded URLs/Endpoints
description: This code contains hardcoded URLs that should be configurable.
fix: Use environment variables or configuration files for URLs.

name: Too Many Function Parameters
description: This function has more than 5 parameters, which reduces readability and maintainability.
fix: Use an options object pattern: function(options) { ... }
examples: function createUser(name, email, age, address, phone, role) { ... }

name: Callback Hell (Pyramid of Doom)
description: This code uses deeply nested callbacks, making it hard to read and maintain.
fix: Use async/await or Promises instead of nested callbacks.

name: Complex Conditional Logic
description: This code contains complex boolean conditions that are hard to understand.
fix: Break complex conditions into named boolean variables or functions.

name: Missing Error Handling
description: This code doesn't handle errors properly, which could cause crashes.
fix: Add try/catch blocks, or check for error conditions explicitly.
